title: $1 vs $1,000,000 Birthday Party
description: One coin flip decided which twin got a million-dollar party. Which party would you have stayed at? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Daisuke: 30-year-old Japanese TV host, slicked-back black hair, shiny gold suit, red bow tie, big confident grin
characters.Rina: 10-year-old Japanese girl, short black bob with a yellow hair clip, pink party dress
characters.Hana: 10-year-old Japanese girl, identical twin of Rina, short black bob with a blue hair clip, plain blue hoodie and jeans

scenes.say: Two twins, one birthday, one coin flip. Heads gets a $1,000,000 party. Tails gets exactly one dollar. Host Daisuke flips the coin, and Rina wins the million.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Bright TV studio, Daisuke in a gold suit holds up a giant shiny coin between twins Rina and Hana. [4-7s] Slow-motion close-up of the coin spinning in the air under spotlights. [7-10s] Rina jumps with joy as confetti falls; Hana stares at a single one-dollar bill in her hand.

scenes.say: So Rina's party has a private island, a 12-layer cake and a live orchestra. Hana spends her one dollar on a single balloon and one birthday candle.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Aerial shot of a tropical island with fireworks, a huge 12-layer cake and an orchestra. [4-7s] A tiny corner shop, Hana counts coins on the counter for one red balloon and one candle. [7-10s] Hana sits alone on a park bench at dusk, the red balloon tied to the bench.

scenes.say: But Daisuke adds one rule: whichever party has more guests at midnight wins another $100,000. Guests can leave by boat any time. Rina laughs. Hana just waits.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Daisuke on a big screen at the island party holding a sign with $100,000 and a clock at midnight. [4-7s] A row of small boats waiting at the island dock. [7-10s] Split frame: Rina laughing with 200 guests, Hana alone on the bench under her balloon.

scenes.say: By 11 p.m., the island has 200 guests and fireworks. The park has zero. Then Rina's phone buzzes: a photo from Hana, one candle, captioned 'Happy birthday, us.'
scenes.video: [0-4s] Wide shot of the crowded island party with fireworks bursting. [4-7s] Empty dark park, Hana lights one candle on the bench. [7-10s] Close-up of Rina's phone screen showing the photo of one candle, Rina's smile fading.

scenes.say: So Rina stops the orchestra, and the whole party takes the boats back. At 11:58, 201 people squeeze into one tiny park around one balloon and one candle.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Rina raises her hand and the orchestra stops mid-note. [4-7s] Dozens of boats crossing a moonlit bay toward the city. [7-10s] A huge crowd fills the small park around Hana's bench; Hana looks up, shocked, holding her candle.

scenes.say: Hana's party wins the $100,000, and she hands all of it to Rina for next year. Rina gives Daisuke back his coin: 'Next year, we flip it together.'
scenes.video: [0-4s] Daisuke announces the winner with a giant check for $100,000 in the park. [4-7s] Hana gives the giant check to Rina; both twins laugh. [7-10s] Rina hands the shiny coin back to Daisuke; the twins hug under the red balloon as the crowd cheers.
